# pantechdynamics_dns_zone (Resource)

A hosted zone on Pantech DNS, on Pantech's own name servers. Create waits until the zone has its two name servers. Point the domain's registrar at name_servers to make the zone active: a domain registered with pantechdynamics_domain is pointed at it for you. Records added before then stay pending: the zone is published on the name servers only once the delegation is proven. The first 5 live zones of an organization are free; each further one is billed monthly (the plan shows the price when it applies). A zone that is not delegated within 14 days is removed (status "failed", failure_code "delegation_timeout"). At most 25 zones per organization, and 10 zone creates in 24 hours. Only an API key made by an owner or admin can change zones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A hosted zone on Pantech DNS. Create waits until the zone has its name
# servers; set them at your domain's registrar to make the zone active.
resource "pantechdynamics_dns_zone" "example" {
  name        = "example.com"
  description = "Marketing site"
}

output "name_servers" {
  value = pantechdynamics_dns_zone.example.name_servers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain the zone serves, in lower case without a trailing dot, such as "example.com". Changing it replaces the zone, and every record in it.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A note for yourself, at most 255 characters. Defaults to "". Changes in place.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the zone was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `domain_id` (String) Id of the Pantech domain (dom_...) that delegates to this zone, or null.
- `failure_code` (String) Why the zone failed, for example "delegation_timeout". Null otherwise.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the zone, starting with dnsz_.
- `name_servers` (List of String) The two Pantech DNS name servers that serve the zone, such as ana.ns.pantechdynamics.com. Set exactly these at the domain's registrar.
- `record_count` (Number) How many record sets the zone holds, including the managed apex SOA and NS.
- `status` (String) State of the zone: "pending" (being created), "awaiting_delegation" (waiting for the registrar to point at name_servers), "active", "suspended", "deleting" or "failed".

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A zone is imported by its id.
terraform import pantechdynamics_dns_zone.example dnsz_06ggf2abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
